mapper.select: select eipd.impairment_type, sum(ecb.depreciation_reserves_amount)*-1 as depreciation_reserves_amount from eg_impairment_provision_detail eipd left join eg_contract_balance ecb on eipd.contract_code = ecb.contract_code and eipd.org_id = ecb.org_id and ecb.del_flag = '0' where eipd.del_flag = '0' and eipd.impairment_type in ('租赁资产', '库存减值') and ((eipd.account_date is not null and to_char(eipd.account_date, 'YYYYMM') = #{periodCode}) or (eipd.account_date is null and to_char(eipd.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{firstDay})) and coalesce(ecb.depreciation_reserves_amount, 0) < 0 and to_char(ecb.voucher_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{firstDay} and ecb.period_code = #{periodCode} group by eipd.impairment_type

select * from eg_impairment_provision_detail t where t.del_flag = '0' and coalesce (t.is_verification,'否') != '是' and ((t.account_date is not null and to_char(t.account_date, 'YYYYMM') = #{periodCode}) or (t.account_date is null and to_char(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{firstDay}))
